list.title: Regulating the healthcare market:
list.snippet: This could include measures to control costs, improve competition among insurers, and protect consumers from unfair practices.

list.title: Improving healthcare delivery:
list.snippet: This may involve introducing new payment models, such as value-based care, or promoting preventive services and wellness programs.

list.title: Reducing healthcare costs:
